about: Hand labels for the strike detector's audit (M1.2, docs/AIMED_OPPONENT.md). Candidates: r1gym/strikes.py audit_candidates (every val speed peak, 36 seeded train ones, then 36 more train ones from the hands only: round 2, added because round 1 held only 13 clear strikes, before any precision or recall was computed). Each was labelled from scripts/strike_sheet.py --proposals sheets: five rendered frames 0.12 s apart around the effector's speed peak (side-on from the opponent's left front, the effector marked, a translucent stand-in R1 at 0.60 m), the effector's forward extension over +-0.5 s and its top-down path. Nothing on the sheets comes from the detector. Rendered with MuJoCo 3.17 on an Intel Arc 140V (OpenGL 4.6, driver 32.0.101.8132) at commit adcd6cb plus the uncommitted M1.2 code.
protocol: strike = 1 if the speed peak belongs to a fast, deliberate drive of the effector toward the stand-in that ends extended in front of the body (punch, palm, hook or swing from behind, chop, rising strike; for a foot, a kick that leaves the floor forward). 0 if at the speed peak the effector retracts, winds up or chambers, swings back or overhead, is held, steps or pivots on the floor, or ends below the stand-in's hips. null (unsure) for slow reaches (< 2 m/s), an already extended arm sliding along the stand-in, or a small re-extension; counted, but left out of precision and recall.
labeller: Labeller: Claude (claude-opus-5-5), the agent that wrote the detector, 2026-10-27, from the sheets alone (sheet = round:sheet.row). Before labelling it had seen a printed list of the detector's strikes for kfab_200 and the first four of kfab_201 while testing the detector; it did not consult it while labelling. One labeller, no second rater: the labels carry its judgement of what counts as a strike.
